name: System pulse
description: How busy this computer is, in plain words: how hard it is thinking, how full its memory is, and which programs are doing the most.
agent: This computer's busyness: system_stats gives processor use, memory use, and the programs using the most of each right now. Use it when something feels slow.

intro.tagline: How busy your computer is, in plain words.
intro.what: A live look at your computer: how hard its processor is thinking, how full its memory is, and which programs are doing the most right now. Each number comes with a sentence saying whether it is fine.
helps: When the computer feels slow, it shows what is to blame.
You can tell at a glance whether there is room to start something big.
Prism can read the same numbers when you ask it why things are slow.
intro.example: The computer suddenly feels sluggish. System pulse shows memory nearly full and Firefox holding 6 GB across its tabs. Closing a few tabs fixes it.
